source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Connect BMC Dedicate port
2. Check BMC netwrok and MAC from Web UI and IPMI OOB "lan print" and check if BMC has only one Bounded LAN chanel
3. Remove BMC Dedicate port, check BMC network and MAC from Web UI and IPMI OOB command "lan print"
4. Plug BMC dedicate port , check BMC network and MAC from Web UI and IPMI OOB command "lan print"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BMC should have same network configuration inculde IP and MAC in three senarios
2. BMC network should work in three scenarios

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this checks the dedicated NIC keeps one bound LAN channel across three scenarios (connect, remove, replug) of the BMC dedicated port. Unplugging/replugging the dedicated-port cable is physical work only a person at the machine can do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator connects/removes/replugs the BMC dedicated port and confirms network+MAC stay consistent; agent could only read `ipmitool lan print` after operator cabling changes.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED due unexplained reachability with dedicated cable absent.

original_test_intent: Validate dedicated-NIC binding across connected, disconnected and reconnected states, but requiring network operation while the dedicated link is absent leaves the alternate path and expected state undefined.
original_method: An engineer recables the dedicated port while WebUI/IPMI network/channel/MAC evidence is observed.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer performs cable states; the agent may collect path-specific reachability and interface evidence.
safety_requirements: Do not assume continued connectivity proves the dedicated path.
Use isolated labeled network and prevent loops/duplicate addresses.
Maintain local/OOB recovery; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, collect link/interface/routes/ARP/MAC/IP and identity-safe reachability per engineer-created state.
Do not recable or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve state matrix and perform physical scenarios.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Physical limitation is correct but insufficient to resolve the acceptance contradiction.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No execution until the disconnected-state path is defined.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Connect/remove/replug, one bound channel, all-three reachability and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define the path expected in each state, then recable while measuring link, binding, failover/failback, endpoint identity and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents another interface from masquerading as dedicated-NIC success.

project_override_considerations: Project failover is allowed only when explicitly mapped and reported; it cannot silently redefine the source.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure removes the dedicated cable, while Criteria still require the BMC network to work without defining a shared/alternate path or whether only configuration persistence is intended.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Success and failure during disconnection have opposite meanings depending on topology; this core semantic ambiguity must be resolved first.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds path attribution and recovery evidence.

review_improvement: Makes dedicated-path identity independently provable rather than accepting any responding BMC interface.
independent_technical_reasoning: Removing the only dedicated physical link necessarily stops traffic on that path; any continued response must use a separately specified path, so the current acceptance cannot be interpreted safely.
